folded_counterexample.rule: (a,u)*(b,v)=(b,v+1) if a=b, and (b,u-v) if a!=b; coordinates modulo 3
folded_counterexample.generic_family: Replace ZMod 3 by any abelian group and 1 by a nonzero e with 3e=0. The identities have defect zero or 3e, while the cross identity has defect e between the fibres.

commuting_proof_idea: Put S(x)=x*x and U(x)=S(x)*x. The candidate identifies the row at I(z,y) with L_y composed with U. Commutativity and involutivity of the rows imply U commutes with all rows and U^2=id. Then c(S(x))=S(x), I(x,x)=U(x), and L_U(x)=L_x composed with U. Combining these with c(x)=U(S(x)) forces U(x)=x and hence both exact basis identities.
